connector.name: Outlook Personal MCP
connector.registryDescription: Full-control MCP server for a personal Outlook.com mailbox and calendar (Microsoft Graph).
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-outlook-personal. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the salahawad account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Azure App Registration client ID (Application ID). Required. Create a free app at https://portal.azure.com — see README for the three-minute setup.

env.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_AUTHORITY
env.description: Azure AD authority URL. Defaults to https://login.microsoftonline.com/consumers which covers personal Microsoft accounts (Outlook.com, Hotmail, Live). Change only if you target a different tenant.

env.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_FILE_ROOT
env.description: Only files under this directory can be read by add_attachment or written by download_attachment. Defaults to ~/.local/share/outlook-personal-mcp/files.

env.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_MAX_FILE_BYTES
env.description: Maximum bytes allowed for local attachment reads and attachment downloads. Defaults to 3145728.

env.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_ALLOW_PERMANENT_DELETE
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable the permanent_delete tool which irrecoverably erases messages (bypasses Deleted Items). Disabled by default for safety.

env.name: OUTLOOK_MCP_DEBUG
env.description: Set to 'true' to enable debug-level logging for Graph API requests and responses.
